# Test: grove prune --force removes a locked worktree whose directory is gone
setup_workspace feature-locked-missing

exec grove add feature-locked-missing
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare worktree lock ../feature-locked-missing --reason keep
rm -rf ../feature-locked-missing
exec grove prune --merged --commit --force
stderr 'Pruned 1 worktree'
stderr 'feature-locked-missing'
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare worktree list --porcelain
! stdout 'feature-locked-missing'
